sticker-yellow.purpose: The action and the label: primary buttons, sticker dots, flags, badges, focus on the mat.

sticker-ink.purpose: The only colour on yellow; also the inset dark band.

ruler.purpose: 40px ticks and mono numerals on the mat edge.

ruler-soft.purpose: 8px minor ticks on the mat edge.

chalk.purpose: Headlines and strong text on the mat and on ink parts.

chalk-dim.purpose: Body copy and nav links on the mat.

chalk-line-strong.purpose: Ghost button outline on the mat.

ink.purpose: Headings and strong text on paper; judged-on chips.

faint.purpose: Labels, captions and fine print on paper.

mark-green.purpose: The good mark on paper: checks, bullets, finding numbers, input focus.

pass-green.purpose: The state after a fix: pass readouts, fixed figures.

fail-red.purpose: The state before a fix: fail readouts, leak reasons.

display.purpose: The hero headline only; the one wide display line.

headline.purpose: Section headlines on the mat, condensed cut.

statement.purpose: The paragraph that lights word by word on scroll.

title.purpose: Offer, step and path titles inside parts.

title-sm.purpose: Titles in the smaller bento parts.

body.purpose: Running text; Dim on paper, Chalk Dim on the mat.

lede.purpose: Section ledes and part copy, 26-36rem measure.

label.purpose: Sentence-case captions, stage names, row heads. Never uppercase.

measure.purpose: Martian Mono for sticker and step numbers, days, code, URLs.

ruler.purpose: Martian Mono ruler numerals on the mat edge.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: Every part at rest, the primary button, signs, FAQ items, the URL field.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Picked up or floating: nav island, request form, open FAQ item, hovered button, dark band.

shadows.name: held
shadows.purpose: Defined third level; no element wears it yet.

shadows.name: part-in-air
shadows.purpose: Hero parts while lifted off the board; arrives on pick-up, leaves when seated (360ms).

shadows.name: button-edge
shadows.purpose: The amber edge and bottom lip on yellow buttons and stickers, layered with flat.

shadows.name: button-pressed
shadows.purpose: Primary button while pressed: flatter than rest.

motion.name: out
motion.purpose: Ease-out-expo for hover, press and small state changes (160ms on buttons and links).

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Mass curve for things a hand moves: nav island (800ms), menu (600-900ms), FAQ marker (700ms), reveals.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.9s + translateY(2.75rem) 1.1s on spring, blur(10px) dropped on the lite tier
motion.purpose: Parts entering on scroll; figures inside stay paused until revealed, then play once.

motion.name: hero-scrub
motion.purpose: Parts lift and spread (0.07-0.34), old parts clear (0.55-0.62), new parts assemble (0.64-0.84), live at 0.86. Transforms and opacity only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Hero shows the finished screen beside the opening words; all main animations off; nav transitions 1ms.

narrative.overview:
The page is a self-healing cutting mat: a deep green field ruled with a pale grid every 40px and a heavier line every 200px, with ruler ticks and numerals printed along its top and left edges. Everything Kyre shows lies on that mat as a physical part: paper cards, ink cards, a product screen at a slight angle. Parts cast the shadow an object casts on a green surface, short contact plus a long soft throw, and they are flat at rest, lifted when picked up. Numbered yellow sticker dots with hairline leaders label the parts, the way a technician labels a disassembly.

The type is one family in two cuts. Archivo, on its width axis, speaks: wide and heavy for the hero line, the wordmark, card titles and prices; condensed and very large for section headlines. Martian Mono only measures: ruler numerals, sticker numbers, step numbers, day cells, code. Yellow is the sticker and the action, and nothing else. Red and green appear only as verdicts on paper (what fails, what passes).

The density is that of a workbench, not a gallery: large headlines on the open mat, then tight, information-carrying parts. Every moving figure plays once when it is revealed and settles; the only continuous motion is the hero's scroll-scrubbed disassembly.
keyCharacteristics: Deep mat-green ground with a two-weight printed grid and ruler edge, everywhere on the page.
Content lives on parts (paper or ink) with green-black object shadows; text on the open mat is chalk only.
One yellow: buttons, sticker dots, flags and badges, focus rings on the mat.
Archivo width axis carries the hierarchy: 70% for section headlines, 104–118% for everything wide.
Martian Mono is reserved for numerals that measure.
Red and green are verdict colours, used small and only on paper.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Sticker Yellow marks either an action or a label, and always carries Sticker Ink on it. It is never body text, never a background wash, never decoration.

rules.name: The Paper On Mat Rule
rules.body: Text set directly on the mat is Chalk or Chalk Dim. Ink, Dim and Faint exist only on paper parts. A reading surface that needs dark text is a part, with its shadow.

rules.name: The Verdict Rule
rules.body: Red and green only say fail and pass, and only on paper or ink parts, at small sizes: a numeral, a dot, a check, a pill. They never colour a heading or a surface.

rules.name: The Two Cuts Rule
rules.body: Width is the hierarchy. Section headlines take the condensed cut (wdth 70); the hero line, the wordmark (wdth 118, weight 800), titles and prices take the wide cut (wdth 104–118). Nothing sits at the default width above body size.

rules.name: The Mono Measures Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono sets only numerals and strings that measure or identify: rulers, part numbers, steps, days, code, URLs. It never sets a sentence, a heading or a button.

rules.name: The Printed Edge Rule
rules.body: The grid and ruler are the mat's own print, not decoration laid over it: they run behind every section at the same 40/200px pitch, and nothing aligns against them by accident. Parts break the grid freely, the way objects lie on a mat.

rules.name: The Object Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is cast by a part onto the mat, so it is green-black and offset downward with negative spread. No neutral grey or blue-black shadows on the mat, no glows, no backdrop blur: the nav island is near-opaque mat green, not glass.

rules.name: The Picked-Up Rule
rules.body: Parts are flat at rest. Elevation rises only in response to state (hover, open, held in the hero), and a pressed button goes flatter than rest.

dos: **Do** put every reading surface on a part (Paper #f6f7f2 or Part Ink #121b16) with the Flat shadow; leave the open mat for headlines, ledes and the hero notes in Chalk and Chalk Dim.
**Do** use Sticker Yellow (#f2d24b) with Sticker Ink (#13241c) for the primary action and for numbered labels, and nowhere else.
**Do** number parts with sticker dots and a hairline leader, and repeat the same number in the text that explains the part.
**Do** set section headlines in Archivo 760 at wdth 70 and everything wide (hero line, titles, prices, wordmark) at wdth 104–118.
**Do** keep Martian Mono to measuring numerals: rulers, part and step numbers, days, code, URLs.
**Do** cast shadows in the mat's green-black (rgba 4 22 14) with negative spread, and raise elevation only on hover, open or pick-up.
**Do** let each figure below the hero play once when revealed and settle; give every animation a reduced-motion end state.
**Do** label every example for what it is with a Faint caption under the figure.
donts: **Don't** use the generic-AI palette (violet-to-pink gradients from #8b5cf6 to #ec4899, navy #1e2130, gradient text) on any Kyre element; it exists only inside the depicted "before" screens being torn down.
**Don't** put Ink, Dim or Faint text directly on the mat, or Chalk text on paper.
**Don't** use red or green for headings, surfaces or decoration; they are fail and pass marks only.
**Don't** use glass, backdrop blur, glows or neutral grey shadows on the mat.
**Don't** set uppercase tracked labels; labels are sentence case at 0.75rem.
**Don't** place a label or eyebrow above a section headline; the headline speaks for itself.
